channel.description:
Buzzcast helps podcasters stay informed, inspired, and excited to keep podcasting.

Each week, Jordan, Kevin, and Alban break down the podcasting news, trends, tools, and creator debates that actually matter. We share what we’re seeing at Buzzsprout, what we’re testing ourselves, and what podcasters should pay attention to without chasing every new thing.

The goal is to help you keep podcasting without burning out. Expect honest opinions, practical takeaways, occasional rabbit trails, and a reminder that podcasting should be fun!

item.description:
Can AI find your podcast? We’re digging into answer engine optimization (AEO), how it overlaps with podcast SEO, and whether making a few changes to an episode can help it show up in AI recommendations.

Jordan put it to the test with a Happy to Help episode that wasn’t appearing in her searches. After updating the title, description, transcript, and chapters, she tried again and the results surprised us! Sure, one experiment isn’t a magic formula, but it gives us some practical ideas to try improving discovery without re-recording anything.

We cover how to:

  • Test your podcast using questions a potential listener would actually ask.
  • Make episode titles and chapter names more specific.
  • Use the “bite, snack, meal” approach to make information more digestible.
  • Clean up transcript errors and make it clear who’s speaking.
  • Help people find the full episode when they discover a clip.

Plus, we talk about Dial Flipper, a podcast discovery app that feels like flipping through radio stations, explain why your listener location stats might look off, and discuss whether podcast app ads are worth the money.

Try this with one of your episodes and send us Fan Mail with what you find. We’re curious to see whether your results surprise you, too!

item.title: Why Your Podcast Stats Don't Add Up (And What Metrics Actually Matter)
item.itunes:summary: This week, we’re sorting through the mess of podcast metrics across YouTube, Spotify, and Apple Podcasts to figure out what those numbers actually tell you about your audience. We discuss why combining stats from different platforms can be misleading, how Buzzsprout counts video downloads, and why a video play doesn’t necessarily mean someone is watching. Plus, we share where to look for more useful feedback, from listener retention graphs to messages from actual humans. Also in this episode...
item.description:
This week, we’re sorting through the mess of podcast metrics across YouTube, Spotify, and Apple Podcasts to figure out what those numbers actually tell you about your audience.

We discuss why combining stats from different platforms can be misleading, how Buzzsprout counts video downloads, and why a video play doesn’t necessarily mean someone is watching. Plus, we share where to look for more useful feedback, from listener retention graphs to messages from actual humans.

Also in this episode:
• Buzzsprout’s new mobile soundbites with editable captions and customizable achievement sharing
• How to find the hidden Buzzsprout logo Easter egg
• Listener tips for finding podcast guests and a father-daughter Columbo podcast that made our day
